install_tell: OSS framework github.com/guardrails-ai/guardrails plus commercial Guardrails Hub at guardrailsai.com. LiteLLM default base http://0.0.0.0:8000 (NO AUTH by default). Operators run a local FastAPI server; production deployments behind operator-managed auth. Hub catalogs Detectors (detect_pii, toxic_language, competitor_check, etc.) published as separate repos.
misconfig_patterns: Default 0.0.0.0:8000 bind exposes guardrails server cluster-wide / VPC-wide / WAN-wide if cluster has no egress restriction
/guards/{name}/openai/v1/chat/completions is a passthrough; if guard is permissive, becomes an open LLM proxy with operator-side OpenAI key
Hub-published Detectors (e.g. detect_pii) ship their own Triton-style app.py; supply-chain surface

active_probe.false_positive_check: reject if body contains "<html" (SPA catch-all). Anchor on json_array + body_contains "playground-session-" + body_contains "validators". Prod tier (api.simlab.guardrailsai.com) is correctly 401 -- do not confuse.

deployment_tells: Default 0.0.0.0:8000 bind is the killer pattern
Operators often containerize and front with Traefik/Nginx on 443
DMARC p=quarantine, pct=100 -- relatively mature enforcement
pivot_paths: Port 8000 sweep on AI-tagged corpora with /guards/ path
Hub repo enumeration on github.com/guardrails-ai for Detector inventory
Cert-CN pivot via guardrailsai.com for commercial customers

vulnerabilities.summary: Unauthenticated GET /guards/ on the Hub Playground API returns every playground user's guard objects. 1,287 objects, 992 distinct OAuth subject IDs. Object id/name keyed playground-session-<provider>|<subject-id> where provider is an Auth0 connection name (google-oauth2|github|auth0) and subject-id is the Auth0 sub. GitHub numeric IDs deanonymize via api.github.com/user/<id>. Wildcard CORS (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *) -> drive-by harvestable cross-origin. Per-user validator selections + thresholds + on-fail modes also disclosed.
vulnerabilities.identity_backbone: Auth0 tenant guardrailsai.us.auth0.com (custom domain auth.guardrailsai.com); authn.guardrailsai.com Express service mints playground-session-* cookies post-Auth0.
vulnerabilities.scope_discipline: Playground (try-it) tier only. Production threat-tester api.simlab.guardrailsai.com/api is correctly 401 (hardened). Validator selections/thresholds exposed, NOT validated prompt/response content. No creds/API keys in listing. Not CRITICAL: identifiers + configs, demo tier, no credential/content exposure.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Require playground session token on /guards/; scope list to caller (object-level authz). Drop wildcard CORS on data endpoints. Replace embedded provider subject IDs with opaque per-session UUIDs.
vulnerabilities.evidence_discipline: 200-with-data confirmed once; sized as counts only (1,287/992/3/45); body shredded; no subject IDs persisted.

category_lane_classification: Lane D (OSS framework + commercial Hub; LiteLLM consumes the OSS server).

disclosure_contact.channel_observed: DMARC reports + GitHub security advisories on guardrails-ai/guardrails

dmarc_posture.insight_80_placement: Series A band (quarantine at pct=100, relaxed alignment, no reject yet)

insight_82_status: CONFIRMED live SaaS find 2026-06-23. Commercial Hub Playground (playground.api.guardrailsai.com, Flask/gunicorn, us-west-2 ELB guardrails-hub-playgroun*) leaks all-tenant guards unauth at /guards/. Prod tier (api.simlab.guardrailsai.com) correctly 401. Demo-tier-weaker pattern.
